# Synthetic recipe pages (import tests)

Written for Table's tests. **Not copied from any website**; names, amounts and wording are invented.
Served only by the in-process fixture transport (`fixtureDeps` in `src/server/recipe-import-service.ts`,
or `TABLE_RECIPE_FETCH_FIXTURES=<this manifest>` in the test environment). Nothing here is fetched from
the network. Host addresses in `manifest.json` are what the fake resolver answers; no connection is made.

URL-to-recipe additions (2026-10-08): `wprm.html` (a WordPress recipe-plugin–shaped page: Yoast-style
`@graph` with `@id` links, HowToSections, an ImageObject), `wprm-fakephoto.html` (the same page on another
host whose "photo" is HTML), `microdata.html` (schema.org microdata only), `photo.png` (a 2×2 PNG
generated by a script, not a photograph of anything), `not-a-photo.png` (HTML bytes served as image/png),
and hosts answering 404, 429 and 500.

Source-policy additions (RUC-01, 2026-10-08): `licensed*.html`, `ungranted.html`, `bb-target.html` and
redirect entries (an allowed link redirecting to another site or to Budget Bytes, a same-site redirect,
photos on a separate CDN host and photos redirecting elsewhere). The Budget Bytes entries exist only so a
test can prove they are **never requested**; every word is invented.
